key.name: toggle-panel
key.description: Keyboard shortcut that opens (and closes) the dice panel in the top bar. Set to an empty list to disable.

key.name: panel-at-pointer
key.summary: Open the panel at the pointer
key.description: When true, the shortcut opens the dice panel next to the mouse pointer, on whichever monitor it is on. When false, the panel drops from the top bar. Clicking the top bar icon always opens it there.

key.name: roll-d4
key.description: Keyboard shortcut that rolls a d4 straight away, without opening the panel. Uses the number of dice currently set in the panel. Empty means no shortcut.

key.name: roll-d6
key.description: Keyboard shortcut that rolls a d6 straight away, without opening the panel. Uses the number of dice currently set in the panel. Empty means no shortcut.

key.name: roll-d8
key.description: Keyboard shortcut that rolls a d8 straight away, without opening the panel. Uses the number of dice currently set in the panel. Empty means no shortcut.

key.name: roll-d10
key.description: Keyboard shortcut that rolls a d10 straight away, without opening the panel. Uses the number of dice currently set in the panel. Empty means no shortcut.

key.name: roll-d12
key.description: Keyboard shortcut that rolls a d12 straight away, without opening the panel. Uses the number of dice currently set in the panel. Empty means no shortcut.

key.name: roll-d20
key.description: Keyboard shortcut that rolls a d20 straight away, without opening the panel. Uses the number of dice currently set in the panel. Empty means no shortcut.

key.name: roll-d100
key.description: Keyboard shortcut that rolls a d100 straight away, without opening the panel. Uses the number of dice currently set in the panel. Empty means no shortcut.

key.name: always-tumble
key.description: Ignore the system Reduced Motion setting (Shell 51 and later) and always play the full drop-and-spin roll. When false and Reduced Motion is on, the die rolls in place with slowly changing faces.

key.name: d100-style
key.description: "pair" rolls two ten-sided percentile dice (tens and units) and shows the total. "ball" rolls a single 100-sided ball.

key.name: dice-monitor
key.description: Connector name of the monitor the dice appear on, such as DP-2. Leave empty to use the monitor under the pointer. If the named monitor is not connected, the monitor under the pointer is used.
